# v4 — IDENTITY, COLLATE, FK CASCADE 演进

在 v3 基础上增加：

- **users.id**: SERIAL → INTEGER GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY
- **users.username**: 增加 COLLATE "en_US"
- **posts.id**: SERIAL → INTEGER GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY
- **posts.user_id FK**: 增加 ON DELETE CASCADE

用于测试 v3→v4 diff 中 SetIdentityOp、AlterColumnCollationOp、FK CASCADE 变更检测。
